scope: Independent targeted JSDOM and source inspection; no source edits, servers, sockets, browser, network or deployment. No visual/layout, native keyboard or acoustic certification.

results.name: Initial dashboard exposes 8 areas, 6 disciplines, 6 languages, 3 utilities and real games without welcome completion or storage
All 23 catalog entries launch from their real area and return with focus
All six bands offer matching real entry; every area prioritizes band and honestly labels age gaps
Six disciplines focus their actual section, disclose readiness and offer only real functional route keys
Six language cards reach the exact three-word pilot, keep fixed age/synthetic voice scope and return
Jump buttons focus and scroll exact headings; Luma/family/progress expose and focus exact destinations with working return
Answered game survives band changes, areas, all utilities, alternate route, home, Continue and reload; welcome preference unchanged
Speech failure on return home remains outside closed catalog and survives dashboard destinations
Unavailable storage remains explicit; dashboard actions neither erase data nor create navigation exceptions
Brand return preserves keyboard focus after an activity has progress
Unconfirmed speech cancellation is not hidden when expanded catalog is collapsed
Audit made no network, microphone or recognition calls
